description: Sample correlation rules that consume existing signalized logs and emit higher-level RCA signals when specific signal sequences occur in order within a time window.

rules.description: Escalate when repeated Kafka rebalance instability is followed by broader Kafka failures.
rules.emit_summary: Kafka consumer-group churn is cascading into broader Kafka failure symptoms.
rules.likely_root_cause: Kafka coordinator instability, broker churn, or overloaded consumers.

rules.description: Escalate when RabbitMQ heartbeat loss is followed by Kafka instability and then generic Kafka failure.
rules.emit_summary: Messaging backbone instability is propagating from RabbitMQ into Kafka processing.
rules.likely_root_cause: Shared network disruption, broker resource exhaustion, or upstream queue pressure.

rules.description: Escalate when MongoDB authentication failures lead to disconnects and then user-facing application errors.
rules.emit_summary: MongoDB authentication problems are now causing application disconnects and 5xx responses.
rules.likely_root_cause: Expired credentials, secret rotation drift, or database role/ACL misconfiguration.

rules.description: Escalate when MongoDB slow operations are followed by disconnects and then frontend 5xx errors.
rules.emit_summary: Database latency has progressed into connection instability and user-visible errors.
rules.likely_root_cause: Slow queries, lock contention, storage saturation, or compute pressure on MongoDB.

rules.description: Escalate when MongoDB performance degradation is followed by host reachability loss and client disconnects.
rules.emit_summary: MongoDB has moved from degraded performance into a connectivity collapse.
rules.likely_root_cause: Network partition, node crash, DNS/routing issue, or severe host resource exhaustion.

rules.description: Escalate when Postgres access control failures are followed by generic Postgres failures and then web 5xx errors.
rules.emit_summary: Postgres access-policy failures are propagating into application-side user errors.
rules.likely_root_cause: pg_hba.conf mismatch, source IP drift, authentication policy drift, or bad connection routing.

rules.description: Escalate when repeated 5xx activity is followed by a critical nginx failure signal.
rules.emit_summary: User-facing HTTP failures have escalated into a critical nginx outage.
rules.likely_root_cause: Upstream failure, worker crash, broken deployment, or severe configuration problem.

rules.description: Escalate when Kafka failure is followed by RabbitMQ heartbeat loss and then nginx failure, indicating broad platform instability.
rules.emit_summary: Failures are now spanning the messaging layer and the user-facing web tier.
rules.likely_root_cause: Shared infrastructure outage, network partition, or host-level resource collapse.

rules.description: Escalate when RabbitMQ heartbeat loss is followed by rising web errors and then critical nginx failure.
rules.emit_summary: Queue heartbeat issues are surfacing as end-user failures at the web edge.
rules.likely_root_cause: Async processing outage, stuck queue consumers, or shared infrastructure instability.
